svg.title: EE8202 Kafka order pipeline architecture
svg.desc: The producer publishes Avro-serialised orders to the orders topic, registering the schema with the Schema Registry. The consumer decodes, validates, delivers with retries and aggregates each order, publishing running-average snapshots to orders.aggregates and routing failures to orders.DLQ.
